name: agent-readiness-module-tests
description: Build-output assertion suite for the agent-readiness Hugo module, run against the published files that twenty-two hugo builds produce: the fixture with every content-license key unset, the same fixture with them set, a minimal build configuring almost nothing (the shape a consumer gets on import), a build with the twins switched off site-wide while the markdown format stays wired, a two-language build that reaches the agent-skills default-language gate, a build with llms.txt off while its format stays wired, an edge build carrying a subpath baseURL and the remaining misconfigurations, a build with every switch off, a build carrying the malformed table shapes TOML cannot express alongside valid ones, a build with the whole agent namespace written as a bare value, a build layering section_pages = false over the default configuration, a build layering link_markdown = false over it with the twins left on, a build layering the three per-surface build_time switches off over it, a build layering llms_index.enable = false over it with the llmsindex format still wired, a build that leaves llmsindex out of the outputs home list while the complete index stays enabled, a build wiring neither link-index format while both surfaces stay enabled, a build layering skills_index.on_supporting_files = 'omit' over it, a shadowing fixture that ships its own layouts/robots.txt, a paginated fixture whose single section spills past pagerSize, a widgets fixture whose single page calls every widget shortcode, and an extra fixture carrying a consumer-authored twin-extra hook partial and an agent_sitemap_heading i18n override. The module ships zero JavaScript, so there is no browser behavior to test.
